text: ポケモンずかん　ぜんぶの　ページ　とうとう　あつめたんだね！

structure.jp: ポケモンずかん　ぜんぶの　ページ
とうとう　あつめたんだね！
structure.en: you've finally collected them, haven't you!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is a spoken のだ. It shows the speaker is reacting to something he has just found out. あつめたんだ = 'so you've collected them'.
